effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may play or use 1 card with [Knightmon] in its text from your hand with the cost reduced by 2.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would leave the battle area, by deleting 1 of your other Digimon with [Knightmon] in its text, it doesn't leave.
